children.text: A full change of clothes (underwear, socks, pants and a shirt) in a labeled bag, weather-appropriate outdoor clothes, and diapers or pull-ups if your child uses them (we provide wipes). A small blanket or comfort item for rest time is welcome. Please keep toys at home unless it is show-and-tell day, and never send toy guns, gum, money or candy. Label everything with your child's name.
